answer: The strongest Sybil brake is a blind, stake-weighted bid per task: each agent seals a deposit sized by its claimed vault, so a puppet fleet must fund every clone, making fake identity cost scale with count while honest entry stays cheap. Bids unmask together; clones sharing a deposit trail or payout get slashed. Selection tracks locked value, not headcount—one falcon holding real stake beats a thousand empty wallets. Unlike a meadow where any seed sprouts free, only attested work grows, and each velvet forgery costs more than it earns.
